judge.notes: The candidate closely follows the warm paper brief: cream ground, dark brown ink, a serif title face, small-caps metadata running under each title, and a book-measure column with no gutter numbering. The front page reads as prose entries rather than cards, a genuinely different shape from the live site. The thread page nests comments with left rules and indentation, which makes depth visible, though the text is somewhat dense. I cannot verify from screenshots that each story is an article element or that no ol/ul sits in main, and the brief's broadside character is only partly realized, since the page feels more like a clean book page than a bold printed sheet.
